title: Non-targeted lipidomics reveals the distinct metabolic mechanisms of nZnO and Zn ions in fish liver
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00160A, Paper
Shuoli Ma, Wen-Xiong Wang
We used lipidomics and bioimaging to assess nZnO and Zn2+ effects on metabolically abnormal grouper. Both Zn treatments reduced liver lipid damage and activated stress-related lipolysis, offering insights into nanometal effects on aquatic health.
